workload.vector_type: dense positive float32, deterministic per unique short note
workload.embedding: in-process synthetic; no network, quota, retry or provider semaphore
workload.source: in-process Memos HTTP transport fixture; no network latency
workload.index: projection-to-publication, empty vector cache; projection import excluded
workload.cold: new application matrix cache per query; OS filesystem pages may be warm
workload.warm: candidate scan with one shared published matrix
workload.service: semantic/hybrid, ten results, live source rereads, 1/2/4 workers
workload.latency: per-operation p50/p95; service worker queue wait excluded
workload.memory: RSS/HWM cover process and fixture; HWM accumulates within each phase process
